documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.text: Our managed services team struggles with inconsistent reporting. We want workflow coordination and account reporting. Please arrange a discovery meeting to understand our requirements. No budget has been approved.

raw_proposal.draft:
Hi [Customer Name],

Thank you for reaching out. We understand your team is looking for workflow coordination and account reporting to address inconsistencies in your managed services reporting. We’d be happy to schedule a discovery meeting to better understand your requirements and explore how Cedar Systems can support your needs.

Please let us know a convenient time to connect.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Cedar Systems Sales Team
[Contact Information]
questions: What is the preferred time for the discovery meeting?
Are there any specific departments or stakeholders who should be included in the meeting?
